# Vidensråd for forebyggelse

Vidensråd for forebyggelse is mentioned once in the corpus, in connection with a discussion of ADHD prevalence trends in Denmark. According to the source document, data from Vidensråd for forebyggelse indicate that the frequency of ADHD is rising [^src1]. This reference appears within a broader document reporting results from Indicator 11 of the ADHD-databasen, which measures the share of adult treatment courses where the patient begins ADHD medication within 120 days of starting a package treatment course — the first time this indicator has been compiled for adults, following the database's 2024 expansion to include adult patients.

No further details about the organization — its structure, mandate, or other activities — are available in the corpus. No relationships or claims involving Vidensråd for forebyggelse are recorded beyond this single reference.
